samples.summary: `applyPasteMerges` is a second implementation of `moveRangeTo`'s merge drop/re-create loop; the move path was not folded into it
samples.evidence: The new `applyPasteMerges` (sheet.ts ~2496) does exactly what `moveRangeTo` still does inline at sheet.ts:2762-2790: delete the replaced/moved blocks (feeding covered srefs into `changedSrefs`), re-create the travelling blocks at translated anchors, call `clearCellsUnderMerge`, then `rebuildMergeCoverMap()`. The task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260912-sheets-paste-merge-propagation-todo.md:27-29) explicitly asks to reuse existing helpers 'rather than writing a second implementation'; that was honoured for `clearCellsUnderMerge` and `crossesFreezePane` but not for the drop/re-create loop itself. Likewise `planPasteMerges`' fully-covered check duplicates the `overwrittenMerges` check at sheet.ts:2673-2679. Cost is internal today (behaviour matches) but drag-move and paste merge semantics can now drift apart.

samples.summary: External-paste merge policy documented in the copy/paste bullet, not recorded as a Non-Goal as the task decision required
samples.evidence: The task decision states the external (TSV/HTML) policy is 'Out of scope for #936; noted as a Non-Goal in `sheet.md`' (docs/tasks/active/20260912-sheets-paste-merge-propagation-todo.md:36-40). The diff adds the rationale inside the copy/paste bullet (docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:133-136) but leaves the file's `### Non-Goals` section (sheet.md:24-28) untouched, so a reader scanning Non-Goals — the section the design template exists to make scannable — does not learn that merge-aware external paste was deliberately declined.

samples.summary: Drag-move's new `merge-move-frozen` refusal is documented under the copy/paste bullet instead of the drag-move bullet
samples.evidence: sheet.md:111-115 describes the drag-move freeze refusal inside the clipboard bullet, while the drag-move bullet (sheet.md:153-162), which already enumerates `merge-source-split` / `merge-dest-partial`, is not updated. The behaviour is documented, just filed away from where a reader of the move semantics will look.

samples.evidence: spreadsheet.ts:724-727 and view/worksheet.ts:4941-4946 explain what a previously-existing `clearCopyBuffer()` call did wrong ('clearing unconditionally demoted every repeat paste…'), which is PR-review commentary rather than design of the code that is there; the same rationale is already captured in docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:121-125 and the task doc. Not a behavioural issue.
